Experts Hub

Georgia Tech is at the forefront of cutting-edge research, spanning fields including engineering, computing, business, health, cybersecurity, and public policy.

Our research professionals welcome opportunities to share their expert analysis and perspectives on the latest news and trends, and you’re in the right place to connect with them. Each photo on this page links to information such as faculty profiles, and social media and research websites highlighting their expertise.

Contact Us Subscribe to Newsletter

Featured Expert

Munmun De Choudhury

College of Computing, School of Interactive Computing

Best known for her foundational research on the intersection of societal mental health and social media interactions, Munmun is an expert in social and computer science.

Learn More

Meet Our Experts

Tibor Besedes

School of Economics

Tibor can succinctly provide explanations and commentary on topics such as economic sanctions, supply chains, trade, and inflation.

Isaiah Bolden

College of Sciences School of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences

Oceanographer Isaiah Bolden focuses his research on the impacts of climate change and changing ocean conditions on coral reefs.

Mariel Borowitz

Sam Nunn School of International Affairs Head of the program on International Affairs, Science, and Technology

Mariel Borowitz’s research deals with international space policy issues, focusing particularly on global developments related to remote sensing satellites and challenges to space security and sustainability.

Rick Clark

Office of the Provost Enrollment Management

Rick Clark is a higher education leader and author whose work centers on college affordability, return on investment, and economic mobility.

Juan-Pablo Correa-Baena

School of Materials Science and Engineering College of Engineering

His work focuses on understanding the relationship between chemistry, crystallographic structure, and properties of emerging semiconducting materials for the development of optoelectronic devices.

Munmun De Choudhury

Anna Erickson

George W. Woodruff School of Mechanical Engineering and Sam Nunn School of International Affairs

Anna Erickson is a sought-after expert on the potential benefits and risks of nuclear energy.

Hermann Fritz

College of Engineering School of Civil and Environmental Engineering

Chris Gaffney

College of Engineering School of Industrial &amp; Systems Engineering

Chris Gaffney is an expert in global supply chain strategy, operations, resilience, and talent development.

Laurie Garrow

College of Engineering School of Civil and Environmental Engineering

Professor Laurie Garrow’s research addresses the development and application of advanced models of travel demand that integrate discrete choice, econometric, and market research methods to enhance understanding of travel behavior.

Santiago Grijalva

College of Engineering School of Electrical and Computer Engineering

Grijalva is a pioneer on decentralized power system architectures and a leading researcher on renewable energy integration and grid cybersecurity.

Timothy Halloran

Scheller College of Business

Tim Halloran specializes in consumer brand strategy, focusing on global brand launches and social media consumer engagement.

Judy Hoffman

College of Computing School of Interactive Computing

Judy Hoffman is a trailblazing computer vision and machine learning expert whose research tackles real-world challenges with a focus on domain adaptation, transfer learning, algorithmic fairness, and adversarial robustness.

Alex Hsu

Scheller College of Business



Alex Hsu is an associate professor of finance in the Scheller College of Business with a research focus on bond yields, equity returns, and macroeconomics.

David Joyner

College of Computing School of Interactive Computing

David Joyner, an accomplished educator and technology enthusiast, excels in advancing online learning while leveraging artificial intelligence and innovative strategies.

Srijan Kumar

College of Computing School of Computational Science and Engineering

Srijan Kumar's expertise is in artificial intelligence, data mining, and online safety, where he pioneers innovative methods to address complex challenges in web security and integrity.

Tom Kurfess

Georgia Tech Research Institute Georgia Tech Manufacturing Institute

Jennifer Leavey

School of Biological Sciences College of Sciences

Jennifer Leavey is an expert in experiential learning in science and education for sustainable development.

Tim Lieuwen

College of Engineering Daniel Guggenheim School of Aerospace Engineering

Tim Lieuwen is an expert in clean energy and propulsion systems, energy policy, acoustics, fluid mechanics, and combustion.

Glenn Lightsey

Daniel Guggenheim School of Aerospace Engineering College of Engineering

Glenn Lightsey’s research focuses on the technology of small satellites, including space exploration, propulsion, satellite operations, Earth monitoring, and space systems engineering.

Brian Magerko

Ivan Allen College of Liberal Arts School of Literature, Media, and Communication

Brian Magerko’s expertise lies at the intersections of computation, cognition, and the social/creative interactions between humans and artificial intelligence.

Feryal Özel

School of Physics

As an expert in astrophysics, Feryal Özel is equipped to offer thoughts on everything from black holes in the Milky Way to the exploration of the moon.

Jud Ready

Georgia Tech Research Institute



Jud Ready is a space and materials science leader with extensive experience directing research programs in aerospace, energy, nanomaterials, and electronics reliability across government, industry, and academia.

Mark Riedl

College of Computing School of Interactive Computing

Mark Reidl is a key expert in artificial intelligence, computational creativity, and AI storytelling for entertainment.

Alex Robel

School of Earth and Atmospheric Sciences College of Sciences

Alex Robel is a leading expert in the fields of climate change and glaciology.

Brian Stone

College of Design School of City and Regional Planning

Brian Stone is a key expert in energy utilization, conservation, climate change, and social and environmental impacts.

Iris Tien

College of Engineering School of Civil and Environmental Engineering

Iris Tien from Georgia Tech is an expert in infrastructure resilience, risk analysis, and the use of data and modeling to improve the reliability and safety of critical infrastructure systems during extreme events.

Mitchell Walker

College of Engineering Daniel Guggenheim School of Aerospace Engineering

Mitchell Walker is one of the world’s leading experts in spacecraft engineering.

Joycelyn Wilson

Ivan Allen College of Liberal Arts School of Literature, Media, and Communication

Joycelyn Wilson is known to many as a “hip-hop scholar,” but she’s actually an educational anthropologist, exploring hip-hop’s intersections with innovation, design, and social justice.

Lisa Yaszek

School of Literature, Media, and Communication Ivan Allen College of Liberal Arts

Lisa Yaszek is a leading scholar and commentator in the field of science fiction literature, particularly its history, cultural implications, and underrepresented voices in the genre, including women and people of color.
